feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: Brewers beat the Rays to win the first World Series title in franchise history
entry.summary: The small-ball Milwaukee Brewers playing in the smallest market in the majors are World Series champions for the first time. The championship comes in the 58th season for a franchise that began as the Seattle Pilots in 1969.

entry.title: Hackers expose the identities of more than 40,000 DHS employees
entry.summary: A group of hacktivists calling themselves Distributed Denial of Secrets, said the unmasking of ICE agents, DHS operatives and contractors was fair play, given the government's lack of transparency.

entry.title: Forecasters are predicting a warmer and wetter winter. Here's how El Niño will affect your region.
entry.summary: El Niño years typically lead to more precipitation and higher-than-average temperatures. The latest data shows the different potential impacts by region.

entry.title: Judge denies the Justice Department's bid to stop processing California ballots
entry.summary: While the judge rejected the Department of Justice's unprecedented demand in California, the case isn't over yet. The federal government immediately filed notice that it will appeal.

entry.title: Trump administration will allow pharmacies to make popular peptides
entry.summary: The Department of Health and Human Services will let small compounding pharmacies make six peptides that haven't been approved by the Food and Drug Administration. It may not be enough to meet demand.

entry.title: Brazilian political drama unfolds as defeated Flavio Bolsonaro arrives in Miami
entry.summary: Defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family have arrived in the U.S. after Brazilian authorities ordered him to surrender his passport. He is facing multiple investigations in Brazil.

entry.title: Trump administration wants to remove regulations on a super planet-heating gas
entry.summary: The Trump administration wants to undo a Biden-era rule that would reduce methane emissions from the oil and gas industry.

entry.title: New book revisits the 2023 killing of an unhoused man in crisis on the NYC subway
entry.summary: Jordan Neely was frightening fellow passengers. A former Marine named Daniel Penny put Neely into a chokehold, killing him. Journalist Anand Giridharadas investigates the incident in Man in the Mirror.

entry.title: Fed holds interest rates steady even as inflation remains stubborn
entry.summary: The Federal Reserve opted to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged — but investors widely expect the central bank to raise rates at its next meeting in December to combat stubborn inflation.

entry.title: Dolores Huerta, influential labor leader, feminist and civil rights icon, dies at 96
entry.summary: Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in the nation's fruit and vegetable fields and coined the phrase "Sí, se puede!" that became a widespread rallying cry.
